'''Y5-X2''' was a green [[R5 series astromech droid|R5 unit]] operating during the [[First Order-Resistance War]]. It served on board the [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|main cruiser]] of the [[Resistance]].<ref name="DroidFactory" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Y5-X2 was created for the [[sequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']]; however, the scene the droid appeared in was ultimately cut before the final release.<ref name="Prop">{{WebCite|url=https://ukm.propstoreauction.com/lot-details/index/catalog/169/lot/47409/Lot-785-STAR-WARS-THE-LAST-JEDI-2017-Y5-X2-Droid-Dome|text=Lot #785 - STAR WARS: THE LAST JEDI (2017) - Y5-X2 Droid Dome|archivedate=20250518034924}}</ref> Despite this, the character still appeared in [[Star Wars: Droid Factory (toy line)|''Star Wars: Droid Factory'']] two-pack of figures tied into the film and released by [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] at ''Star Wars'' [[Celebration Orlando]] in [[April]], 2017,<ref name="DroidFactory" /> and ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and released alongside the film on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref>
